# End of Tenancy Cleaning Merseyside & North West | All Cleanz

URL: https://www.allcleanz.co.uk/end-of-tenancy-cleaning

## End of Tenancy Cleaning across Merseyside & the North West

Using a comprehensive end of tenancy cleaning checklist approved by agencies, this professional commercial and domestic cleaning service will help to take the stress out of moving. It will also ensure your landlord receives a sparkly clean property, and you get your deposit back.

### What’s included

This service takes place once all your belongings have been removed and includes, but is not limited to, the following:

#### All rooms

We vacuum and mop floors, clean doors and frames, polish door handles, remove cobwebs, wipe skirting, clean light switches, polish interior glass and window sills, spot clean dirt and stains from walls and remove waste.

#### The bedrooms

Clean wardrobes, bed frames, decorative items and electronics.

#### The bathroom

Disinfect and clean bathtub, shower and toilet bowl, clean tiles, polish mirrors, clean cabinets, descale sinks and clean taps.

#### The kitchen

Clean cupboards, clean dirt and stains off counter tops, clean the vent, scrub hob, knobs and burners, clean refrigerator and kitchen appliances.

#### The living room

Dust furniture (emphasis on fine details), dust all accessories, decorative items, shelves and hangings, clean electronics and vacuum upholstery.

#### Hallway & stairs

Polish the front door and clean rugs.

## Domestic Cleaning across Merseyside & the North West

This personalised service will help to keep on top of all your domestic cleaning chores. A daily, weekly or monthly clean that is tailored to meet your needs.

### Room by room

#### The bedrooms

Your haven for relaxation and a peaceful night’s sleep. Let us clean away the mess to create a soothing space.

What’s included: dust and wipe all accessible surfaces; wipe switches and handles; make the bed (if fresh linen has been left out); vacuum and mop the floor and remove rubbish.

#### The bathroom

A place for privacy and peace, for soaking and unwinding. Let us leave you singing in the shower.

What’s included: clean the toilet; scrub shower, bath and sink; clean cabinet exteriors and mirrors; wipe switches and handles; vacuum and mop the floor and rubbish removal.

#### The kitchen

The place of family congregations, the heart of the home. Let us make yours spotlessly clean and sanitised from any hazards to health.

What’s included: wash dishes or load the dishwasher; dust and wipe all accessible surfaces; wipe exterior of kitchen cupboards, oven, fridge and fixtures; wipe switches and handles; vacuum and mop floors; scrub the hob; wipe counter tops; clean the sink; put away clean dishes; rubbish and recycling removed.

#### The living room

One of the most used rooms in any household. Whether you’re snuggling down on the sofa eating snacks, playing with the kids or entertaining friends, you’re creating dirt, stains and smears on all the surfaces and floors. Let us bring a warm glow back to your hearth.

What’s included: dust and wipe all accessible surfaces; wipe switches and handles; clean mirrors; vacuum and mop floor and rubbish removal.

#### Hallway & stairs

Often these are the areas that get dirtier than most as we pass along them on our way to the other rooms in the house. Let us light up the entrance to your home.

What’s included: polish the front door; dust woodwork; mopping and vacuuming; spot removal of mud, dirt and stains from walls, railings and stairs; wipe skirting and clean rugs.

# Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning Merseyside | All Cleanz

URL: https://www.allcleanz.co.uk/carpet-upholstery-cleaning

## Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning across Merseyside & the North West

For carpet, upholstery and hard floor cleaning we use the most advanced cleaning system: the patented [Texatherm® process](https://www.texatherm.com/). This process combines market leading technology with state of the art equipment to produce a variety of cleaning methods, each with its own benefits.

### Advanced carpet, upholstery & hard floor cleaning

Our Texatherm® trained technicians can clean carpets, upholstery and hard floors using multiple cleaning methods, all from just one machine. They can adapt immediately whilst on site, switching between cleaning methods and processes in minutes, depending on our client’s needs.

#### These methods include

- Hot water extraction
- Texatherm® low moisture cleaning
- Texatherm® dual combination cleaning
- Restorative cleaning
- Hard floor cleaning
- Upholstery and sofa cleaning

### Hot water extraction

The hot water extraction (HWE) cleaning method is suitable for cleaning most carpets, sofas, upholstery and other textiles, as long as they are not water sensitive.

To get the best performance from a carpet extraction machine, it needs to be able to pull air flow through the carpet backing. However, not all carpet types allow for this.

Office carpet tiles, for example, are constructed with watertight backings, which stop any airflow from being pulled through the backing and up the carpet fibres. This lack of airflow dramatically reduces the performance of a hot water extraction machine, so a low moisture system may be better suited and will give superior results.

### Low moisture cleaning

The Texatherm® low moisture cleaning process is a great alternative to HWE. It uses a combination of chemicals that react with an absorbent heated pad to create a capillary wicking action that draws dirt and stains out of the carpet fibres and onto the pad.

This method does not need airflow through the carpet backing to work effectively, so it gives safer, superior cleaning results on commercial carpet tiles that dry very quickly. The process is also much quieter and dramatically reduces cleaning time when compared with HWE cleaning.

### Benefits of low moisture cleaning

- A superior clean on synthetic commercial carpet tiles
- Cleaning time reduced by up to 60% when compared to conventional cleaning methods
- A more environmentally friendly way to clean carpets: water consumption is cut by up to 80%, and 80% less foul water returns to drains
- Low noise means less disruption in the workplace
- A low moisture clean, with all the benefits normally associated with a dry cleaning system
- 30 minute drying time

Using the most advanced and environmentally friendly Texatherm® cleaning machine and process means textiles will dry out in just 30 minutes, guaranteed.

# Fridge Cleaning Merseyside & North West | All Cleanz

URL: https://www.allcleanz.co.uk/fridge-cleaning

## Fridge Cleaning across Merseyside & the North West

Your kitchen is not clean unless your fridge is clean. The fridge is often an overlooked area of commercial and domestic household sanitation.

### Why clean your fridge?

We tend to keep our kitchen floors and surfaces immaculately clean, but the fridge can be neglected for months, even years.

If a fridge is not cleaned regularly it can become a breeding ground for dangerous bacteria. These bacteria can survive at low temperatures, so not only will your fridge start to smell, but your food can become contaminated and unsafe to eat.

#### Get rid of

- Unpleasant smells
- Lingering spills and stains
- Dangerous bacteria and mould

### Why choose All Cleanz?

We are totally committed to our customers and to the quality of service we provide.

#### Expert cleaners

# Privacy Policy | All Cleanz

URL: https://www.allcleanz.co.uk/privacy-policy

## Privacy Policy Last updated 13 November 2026

This policy explains what personal information All Cleanz collects when you use our website or get in touch, how we use it, and the rights you have over it. We only collect what we need to answer your enquiry, carry out our cleaning services and run our business.

### Who we are

All Cleanz (“we”, “us”, “our”) is a domestic and commercial cleaning company based in Prescot, Merseyside, working across the North West of England. We are responsible for the personal information described in this policy.

If you have any questions about this policy or your information, contact us:

- Email: [enquiries@allcleanznorthwest.co.uk](mailto:enquiries@allcleanznorthwest.co.uk)
- Phone or WhatsApp: [07721 938429](tel:+447721938429)

### The information we collect

#### When you ask for a quote or contact us

If you use our quote form, call us, email us or message us on WhatsApp, we collect the details you give us. This usually includes your name, email address, phone number, town or postcode, the type and size of your property, the service you’re interested in and any message you send.

#### When you book a clean

To carry out and invoice the work, we also keep details such as your address, how we can access the property, the services booked and any notes you give us about your home or premises.

#### When you apply to join the team

If you apply for a job with us, we collect your name, email address, phone number, the role you’re applying for, when you can start, and your CV along with anything else you choose to include in it.

#### When you visit our website

The company that hosts our website automatically records basic technical information when pages are requested, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages visited. This is used to keep the website running securely. We do not use this information to identify you.

### How we use your information

Under UK data protection law we must have a lawful reason for using your personal information. We use it:

- To reply to your enquiry and give you a quote. This is a step you have asked us to take before entering into a contract with us.
- To carry out the cleaning services you book, arrange visits and send invoices. This is necessary to perform our contract with you.
- To keep business and tax records. This is necessary to meet our legal obligations.
- To consider your job application and contact you about it. This is a step you have asked us to take before entering into a contract with us.
- To keep our website secure and working properly. This is in our legitimate interests.

We will not send you marketing messages unless you have asked us to, and we never sell your personal information.

### Who we share it with

We only share your information with the people and services that help us run the business, and only as much as they need:

- the company that hosts our website and handles our online forms
- our email, phone and messaging providers, including WhatsApp if you choose to message us there
- our accountant, and HMRC where the law requires it

Some of these providers may store information outside the UK, for example in the United States. Where that happens, they protect it with safeguards recognised under UK data protection law.

### How long we keep it

- Enquiries and quotes that don’t lead to a booking: up to 12 months.
- Customer records and invoices: 6 years from the end of the tax year they relate to, as required for tax purposes.
- Job applications that are not successful: up to 6 months. If you join the team, your application becomes part of your staff record.

After these periods we securely delete or destroy the information.

### Cookies

Our website does not use cookies for advertising or tracking. If we add website analytics in the future, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where the law requires it.

Our website links to other sites, such as Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Google. Those sites have their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for how they use your information.

### Your rights

You have the right to:

- ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you
- ask us to correct information that is wrong or incomplete
- ask us to delete your information
- ask us to limit how we use your information, or object to us using it
- ask for your information in a format you can take to another provider

Some of these rights only apply in certain situations. To use any of them, email or call us using the details above. We will respond within one month, and there is usually no charge.

### How to complain

If you’re unhappy with how we have handled your information, please contact us first so we can put it right. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO), the UK’s data protection regulator, at [ico.org.uk](https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint/) or on 0303 123 1113.

### Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page, with the date it was last updated.
